# Code-host foundation and GitLab token connect

## What to build

This slice lays the foundation for the native GitHub/GitLab integration (PRD: `CODE-HOST-INTEGRATION-PRD.md` at the repo root — read sections 6, 9 and 10). It delivers one working vertical path: a signed-in user connects **GitLab** by pasting a base URL and an access token, Rakazo validates the token's scopes against the GitLab REST API, stores the token encrypted, lists the projects the token can reach, lists and disconnects connections. Layers touched: a provider-neutral `CodeHostProvider` contract in `@rakazo/adapter-kit`, zod schemas + oRPC contract in `@rakazo/contracts`, **all** new Prisma models for the feature (additive migration with row-level security), a GitLab adapter and an offline code-host emulator in `@rakazo/adapters`, a shared credential service, and oRPC procedures in `apps/api`. Later slices add GitHub, repository binding, the git proxy, tools and UI on top of exactly the shapes defined here, so follow the names below precisely.

Decisions already made (do not revisit): code-host connections get their **own** `CodeHostConnection` table (do NOT reuse `Connection` — the run executor treats every `Connection` row as a Composio app); there are no new environment variables; GitHub (next slice) also connects by token only.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `CODE-HOST-INTEGRATION-PRD.md` (sections 9–10) — contract sketch, data model, scopes, API shapes.
- `packages/adapter-kit/src/messaging-installations.ts` (whole file, 34 lines) — style of a vendor contract interface.
- `packages/adapter-kit/src/cloud-agents.ts` (lines 5–31) — reason-typed error classes to mirror.
- `packages/adapter-kit/src/secret-errors.ts` (lines 1–17) — error class style (`readonly code`, `this.name`).
- `packages/adapter-kit/src/index.ts` — flat `export * from "./x.js"` barrel; add the new file.
- `packages/adapters/src/cloud-agent-emulator.ts` (lines 25–48, 181–196) — wire emulator with a `fetch` property, request log and fault toggles.
- `packages/adapters/src/mcp-emulator.ts` (lines 9–67) — real `node:http` server on `127.0.0.1` port 0 with `start()`/`stop()`; the code-host emulator needs a real server because the `git` CLI must reach it in later slices.
- `packages/adapters/src/billing-conformance.test.ts` (lines 11–75) — Harness + factory map conformance pattern to mirror.
- `packages/adapters/src/cursor-cloud-agent.ts` constructor — options object with injectable `fetch`.
- `packages/adapters/src/remote-mcp.ts` (lines 39–48, 159–260) — `createSafeRemoteFetch(baseFetch?, resolve?, { allowPrivateEndpoint })` SSRF-safe fetch: rejects non-https for public hosts, private hosts unless allowed, and redirects (throws `ConnectorRedirectError`).
- `packages/adapters/src/messaging-installations.ts` (lines 108–164, 289–315) — `secrets.put(plaintext, ctx, { recordId })` → store `ciphertext` on the row; `secrets.load(ciphertext, rowId)`; `secrets.delete(ref, rowId)` best effort with cleanup.
- `packages/adapter-kit/src/interfaces.ts` (lines 429–443) and `packages/adapter-kit/src/types.ts` (lines 799–811) — `SecretStore` and `SecretRecord`; ciphertext is bound to the record id.
- `packages/db/src/row-id.ts` — `createRowId()`; encrypted rows need their id before insert.
- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` — `Connection` (line ~1223), `MessagingInstallation` (~2143), `Bot` (~640), `Run` (~873), `Space` (~355), `User` (~24) for relation/back-relation style.
- `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261025130000_messaging_installations/migration.sql` — additive table + RLS policy pattern to copy.
- `packages/db/src/row-security.ts` (line 96, `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS`) — every new tenant table must be listed; `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789` fails otherwise.
- `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts` (line 241 `appContract`; lines 1054–1101 `connections` and `messaging.installations`) — contract-first oRPC.
- `packages/contracts/src/domain.ts` (lines 735–744 `ConnectionSchema`, 1194–1208) and `packages/contracts/src/integration-settings.ts` (lines 3–14) — zod schema/type pairs.
- `apps/api/src/router.ts` (lines 59–164) — `RouterDeps` and `createRouter` composition; add `...codeHostsRoutes(ctx)`.
- `apps/api/src/routes/context.ts` (lines 330–340) — `authed` builder (runs under `asTenant`).
- `apps/api/src/routes/messaging.ts` (lines 19–46) — a small route module to mirror.
- `apps/api/src/security-audit.ts` (lines 19–87) — `AUDITED_PROCEDURES` table for automatic security events.
- `apps/api/src/app.ts` (lines 236–257 `CreateAppOverrides`; 314–320 secrets; 730–812 `createRouter({...})`) — composition root.
- `apps/api/src/router-messaging.test.ts` (lines 21–312) — unit test calling procedures through `RPCHandler` with fake deps.
- `apps/api/src/plugin-installs.postgres.test.ts` (lines 17–125) — Postgres test harness pattern.

## Patterns to follow

**Naming / file conventions:**
```
packages/adapter-kit/src/code-host.ts          # contract + errors (export from index.ts)
packages/contracts/src/code-host.ts            # zod schemas (export from index.ts)
packages/adapters/src/code-host-emulator.ts    # offline emulator (HTTP server), exported from index.ts
packages/adapters/src/gitlab-code-host.ts      # GitLab adapter
packages/adapters/src/code-host-factory.ts     # createCodeHostProviders()
packages/adapters/src/code-host-credentials.ts # load/delete stored credential for a connection
packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts
apps/api/src/routes/code-hosts.ts              # export function codeHostsRoutes(ctx: RouterContext)
```
Prisma: models PascalCase, columns camelCase, `@@map("snake_plural")`, ids `String @id @default(cuid())`.

**Error handling (adapter-kit):**
```ts
// mirror packages/adapter-kit/src/cloud-agents.ts:5-31
export class CodeHostRequestRejected extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly reason: "invalid_url" | "unauthorized" | "missing_scopes" | "excess_scopes" | "not_found" | "unreachable",
    readonly detail: string[] = [],
  ) { super(`Code host request rejected: ${reason}`); this.name = "CodeHostRequestRejected"; }
}
export class CodeHostRetryLater extends Error { /* reason: "rate_limited" | "unavailable"; retryAfterMs? */ }
```
In API handlers translate: `invalid_url` → `ORPCError("BAD_REQUEST", { message })`; `unauthorized` → `ORPCError("BAD_REQUEST", { message: "The token was rejected" })`; `missing_scopes`/`excess_scopes` → `ORPCError("UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT", { status: 422, data: { error: reason, missing|excess: detail } })` (if `UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT` is not an accepted code in this oRPC version use `BAD_REQUEST` with `data`); `unreachable` → `BAD_REQUEST` "Could not reach <host>". **Never** include the token in any message, log line or error `cause` that is serialized.

**Secret storage (inline ciphertext on the row, like MessagingInstallation):**
```ts
const id = createRowId();
const sealed = await deps.secrets.put(JSON.stringify(credential), adapterContext, { recordId: id });
await deps.prisma.codeHostConnection.create({ data: { id, ..., ciphertext: sealed.ciphertext } });
// load: JSON.parse(await secrets.load(row.ciphertext, row.id))
```

**Test pattern:** conformance via a `Record<string, () => Harness>` factory map and `for (const [name, create] of Object.entries(factories)) describe(...)` as in `billing-conformance.test.ts`; API unit tests through `RPCHandler` like `router-messaging.test.ts`; Postgres tests skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/adapter-kit/src/code-host.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** exactly these exported types (later slices extend this file; keep names):
```ts
export type CodeHostKind = "github" | "gitlab";
export type CodeHostAuthKind = "token" | "oauth";
/** Server-side only. Never sent to a sandbox, a client or a log. */
export interface CodeHostSecret { token: string; refreshToken?: string; expiresAt?: string; oauthClientId?: string; oauthClientSecret?: string }
export interface CodeHostIdentity {
  hostUserId: string; username: string; displayName: string;
  /** true for GitLab project/group token bot users */
  isBotUser: boolean;
  /** no-reply email for this user on the host, used as committer email */
  noreplyEmail: string;
}
export interface CodeHostConnectionRef {
  id: string; provider: CodeHostKind; baseUrl: string; authKind: CodeHostAuthKind;
  secret: CodeHostSecret; identity: CodeHostIdentity;
}
export interface CodeHostRepository { hostRepoId: string; fullPath: string; defaultBranch: string }
export interface VerifiedCodeHostCredential { identity: CodeHostIdentity; label: string; scopes: string[] }
export interface GitCredential { username: string; password: string }
export interface CodeHostProvider {
  readonly provider: CodeHostKind;
  /** Validate base URL + token, check scopes; throws CodeHostRequestRejected. */
  connectToken(input: { baseUrl: string; token: string; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<VerifiedCodeHostCredential>;
  listRepositories(connection: CodeHostConnectionRef, query?: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<CodeHostRepository[]>;
  getRepository(connection: CodeHostConnectionRef, hostRepoId: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<CodeHostRepository>;
  /** Basic-auth pair the git proxy uses upstream. */
  gitCredential(connection: CodeHostConnectionRef): GitCredential;
  /** https URL of the repository's smart-HTTP endpoint, ending in ".git", no credentials. */
  remoteUrl(connection: CodeHostConnectionRef, repo: CodeHostRepository): string;
}
```
  plus `CodeHostRequestRejected` and `CodeHostRetryLater` (see pattern above).
- **IMPORTS**: none.
- **GOTCHA**: keep `CodeHostProvider` free of vendor names in method names. Later slices add `compare`, `openChangeRequest`, `isAncestor`, `refresh`, `revoke` — do not add them now.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/adapter-kit check`

### UPDATE `packages/adapter-kit/src/index.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: add `export * from "./code-host.js";` (keep alphabetical-ish order).

### CREATE `packages/contracts/src/code-host.ts` and UPDATE `packages/contracts/src/index.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** (`import * as z from "zod"`, `Id` from `./ids.js`):
```ts
export const CodeHostKindSchema = z.enum(["github", "gitlab"]);
export const CodeHostConnectionSchema = z.object({
  id: Id, provider: CodeHostKindSchema, baseUrl: z.string(), authKind: z.enum(["token", "oauth"]),
  label: z.string(), createdAt: z.string(),
});
export const CodeHostRepositorySchema = z.object({ hostRepoId: z.string(), fullPath: z.string(), defaultBranch: z.string() });
export const CodeHostBaseUrlSchema = z.string().trim().url().max(2048);
export const CodeHostTokenInputSchema = z.object({ baseUrl: CodeHostBaseUrlSchema, token: z.string().trim().min(1).max(4096) });
```
  with `export type X = z.infer<typeof XSchema>` for each. Add `export * from "./code-host.js";` to `packages/contracts/src/index.ts`.

### UPDATE `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: add to `appContract` (next to `connections`):
```ts
codeHosts: {
  connections: {
    list: oc.output(z.array(CodeHostConnectionSchema)),
    remove: oc.input(z.object({ connectionId: Id })).output(z.object({ ok: z.literal(true) })),
  },
  gitlab: { connectToken: oc.input(CodeHostTokenInputSchema).output(CodeHostConnectionSchema) },
  repositories: {
    list: oc.input(z.object({ connectionId: Id, query: z.string().trim().max(200).optional() }))
      .output(z.object({ repositories: z.array(CodeHostRepositorySchema) })),
  },
},
```
- **GOTCHA**: RPC paths become `codeHosts/connections/list`, `codeHosts/gitlab/connectToken`, `codeHosts/repositories/list`, `codeHosts/connections/remove`. Later slices add `codeHosts.github.connectToken`, `codeHosts.gitlab.oauth.*` and `bots.repositories.*` — don't add them now.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/contracts check`

### UPDATE `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma`
- **IMPLEMENT** all five models now (later slices only use them). Every table carries `spaceId` + `userId` for RLS:
```prisma
/// A connected GitHub or GitLab account. Separate from `Connection`, which the run engine reads as Composio apps.
model CodeHostConnection {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  spaceId    String
  space      Space    @relation(fields: [spaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  provider   String   // "github" | "gitlab"
  baseUrl    String   // normalized web base URL, e.g. https://gitlab.example.com
  authKind   String   // "token" | "oauth"
  label      String
  ciphertext String   // SecretStore ciphertext of CodeHostSecret JSON, bound to this row id
  metadata   Json     @default("{}") // CodeHostIdentity + scopes
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt
  repositories BotRepository[]
  @@index([spaceId, userId])
  @@map("code_host_connections")
}
model BotRepository {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  spaceId       String
  space         Space    @relation(fields: [spaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId        String
  botId         String
  bot           Bot      @relation(fields: [botId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  connectionId  String
  connection    CodeHostConnection @relation(fields: [connectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  hostRepoId    String
  fullPath      String
  defaultBranch String
  branchPrefix  String   // "rakazo/<bot-slug>/"
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  branches      BotRepositoryBranch[]
  grants        GitProxyGrant[]
  pushApprovals GitPushApproval[]
  @@unique([botId, connectionId, hostRepoId])
  @@index([spaceId, userId])
  @@map("bot_repositories")
}
model BotRepositoryBranch {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  spaceId         String
  userId          String
  botRepositoryId String
  botRepository   BotRepository @relation(fields: [botRepositoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  ref             String   // full ref, refs/heads/rakazo/<slug>/...
  createdByRunId  String
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  @@unique([botRepositoryId, ref])
  @@map("bot_repository_branches")
}
/// Per-run credential handed to the bot computer. No timer: valid while its run is active, deleted when it ends.
model GitProxyGrant {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  spaceId         String
  userId          String
  tokenHash       String   @unique
  runId           String
  run             Run      @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  botRepositoryId String
  botRepository   BotRepository @relation(fields: [botRepositoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  @@index([runId])
  @@map("git_proxy_grants")
}
/// One approved GitLab push: this run may set `ref` on this repository to `newSha` once.
model GitPushApproval {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  spaceId         String
  userId          String
  runId           String
  run             Run       @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  botRepositoryId String
  botRepository   BotRepository @relation(fields: [botRepositoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  ref             String
  newSha          String
  effectId        String    @unique
  usedAt          DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  @@index([runId, botRepositoryId, ref])
  @@map("git_push_approvals")
}
```
  Add back-relations: `Space` → `codeHostConnections CodeHostConnection[]`, `botRepositories BotRepository[]`; `User` → `codeHostConnections CodeHostConnection[]`; `Bot` → `repositories BotRepository[]` (append after existing back-relations, as `messagingInstallations` is); `Run` → `gitProxyGrants GitProxyGrant[]`, `gitPushApprovals GitPushApproval[]`.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm db:generate`

### CREATE `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261111120000_code_host_integration/migration.sql`
- **IMPLEMENT**: first line `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these tables.` Then `CREATE TABLE` for the five tables (TEXT ids, `TIMESTAMP(3)` with `DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`, `JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'`, FKs `REFERENCES "spaces"("id")`, `"user"("id")`, `"bots"("id")`, `"runs"("id")`, `"code_host_connections"("id")`, `"bot_repositories"("id")` all `ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE`), the unique/regular indexes Prisma expects (names `<table>_<cols>_key` / `<table>_<cols>_idx`), and for **each** table:
```sql
ALTER TABLE "code_host_connections" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY code_host_connections_system ON "code_host_connections" USING (current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on');
CREATE POLICY code_host_connections_tenant ON "code_host_connections" USING (
 "spaceId" = NULLIF(current_setting('app.space_id', true), '') AND
 "userId" = NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), ''));
```
- **GOTCHA**: the timestamp must sort after `20261110120000` (the latest existing migration). The generated SQL must match the Prisma schema exactly — after writing it, run `pnpm --filter @rakazo/db exec prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script` (with a shadow DB if needed) or the postgres tests to confirm there is no drift; fix until empty.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm test:integration --spec=row-security`

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/row-security.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: add `"CodeHostConnection"`, `"BotRepository"`, `"BotRepositoryBranch"`, `"GitProxyGrant"`, `"GitPushApproval"` to `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS`.

### CREATE `packages/adapters/src/code-host-emulator.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** `export class CodeHostEmulator` — an in-process **real HTTP server** (pattern: `mcp-emulator.ts` `start(port = 0)` / `stop()` on `127.0.0.1`) so both `fetch` and (later) the `git` CLI can use it:
  - `constructor(readonly flavor: "github" | "gitlab")`; `baseUrl` getter (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>`) valid after `start()`.
  - State: `tokens: Map<string, { scopes: string[]; user: { id: number; username: string; name: string; bot: boolean } }>`, `projects: Map<string, { id: string; fullPath: string; defaultBranch: string; members: Set<string /*token*/> }>`; helpers `addToken(token, { scopes, user })`, `addProject({ fullPath, defaultBranch?, tokens: string[] })` returning the project id; `requests: Array<{ method; path; query }>` log; `failNext(status: number)` fault toggle.
  - GitLab REST (`/api/v4`), auth via `PRIVATE-TOKEN` or `Authorization: Bearer` header, 401 `{ message: "401 Unauthorized" }` otherwise:
    - `GET /api/v4/personal_access_tokens/self` → `{ id, name, scopes, active: true, expires_at: null }`
    - `GET /api/v4/user` → `{ id, username, name, bot, email: null }`
    - `GET /api/v4/projects?membership=true&min_access_level=30&simple=true&per_page=100&search=<q>` → `[{ id, path_with_namespace, default_branch, http_url_to_repo }]` (only projects the token is a member of; `search` filters case-insensitively on `path_with_namespace`)
    - `GET /api/v4/projects/:id` → same shape; 404 `{ message: "404 Project Not Found" }` when not a member.
  - Leave room for a GitHub flavor (next slice) and git smart-HTTP (`git http-backend`, slice 4): structure routing as `handleGitlab(req)` / `handleGithub(req)` (the latter can throw "not implemented" for now).
- **GOTCHA**: export it from `packages/adapters/src/index.ts` (it is test support but lives in src like `email-emulator.ts`). Only bind `127.0.0.1`.

### CREATE `packages/adapters/src/gitlab-code-host.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** `export class GitlabCodeHostProvider implements CodeHostProvider` with `constructor(private readonly options: { fetch?: typeof fetch } = {})`, `provider = "gitlab"`:
  - `normalizeBaseUrl(raw)`: `new URL`, require `https:` (or `http:` only when the injected fetch will be allowed by the composition root — simply allow `http:` here and let the safe fetch enforce HTTPS for public hosts), strip trailing `/`, no credentials/query/hash → else `CodeHostRequestRejected("invalid_url")`. Default for gitlab.com: `https://gitlab.com`.
  - `connectToken`: `GET {base}/api/v4/personal_access_tokens/self` with header `PRIVATE-TOKEN: <token>` (works for personal, project and group tokens); 401/403 → `unauthorized`; required scopes `["api", "write_repository"]` (`api` alone does not grant git push over HTTP for project tokens — require both) → `missing_scopes` with the missing list. Then `GET /api/v4/user` → identity `{ hostUserId: String(id), username, displayName: name, isBotUser: Boolean(bot), noreplyEmail: \`${id}-${username}@users.noreply.${new URL(base).hostname}\` }`; `label = username`. Network errors (fetch throws) → `unreachable`. 429/5xx → `CodeHostRetryLater`.
  - `listRepositories`: `GET /api/v4/projects?membership=true&min_access_level=30&simple=true&per_page=100` (+ `&search=`) → map to `{ hostRepoId: String(id), fullPath: path_with_namespace, defaultBranch: default_branch ?? "main" }`. Auth header: `PRIVATE-TOKEN` for `authKind: "token"`, `Authorization: Bearer` for `oauth`.
  - `getRepository`: `GET /api/v4/projects/:id`; 404 → `not_found`.
  - `gitCredential`: `{ username: "oauth2", password: secret.token }`.
  - `remoteUrl`: `${baseUrl}/${fullPath}.git`.
  - Every request: `signal: AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(15_000)].filter(Boolean))`, `redirect: "manual"`.
- **GOTCHA**: never put the token in URLs or thrown messages.

### CREATE `packages/adapters/src/code-host-factory.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
```ts
export type CodeHostProviders = Record<CodeHostKind, CodeHostProvider | undefined>;
export function createCodeHostProviders(options: { fetch?: typeof fetch } = {}): CodeHostProviders {
  return { gitlab: new GitlabCodeHostProvider(options), github: undefined };
}
```
  (the GitHub slice fills `github`). Export from `packages/adapters/src/index.ts`.

### CREATE `packages/adapters/src/code-host-credentials.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** helpers used by the API and the worker (the shared source of truth for reading a connection):
  - `export async function loadCodeHostConnection(prisma, secrets, row): Promise<CodeHostConnectionRef>` — decrypts `row.ciphertext` with `secrets.load(row.ciphertext, row.id)`, parses `CodeHostSecret`, reads identity from `row.metadata.identity`.
  - `export async function deleteCodeHostConnection(prisma, secrets, { id, spaceId, userId })` — deletes the row (cascades bindings, branches, grants, approvals) inside a transaction scoped by `spaceId`/`userId` (throw `IsolationError` from `@rakazo/db` when 0 rows), then `secrets.delete(ciphertext, id)` best effort (log a warning on failure, like `messaging-installations.ts` `cleanupCredential`).
- Export from the adapters barrel.

### CREATE `apps/api/src/routes/code-hosts.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** `export function codeHostsRoutes(ctx: RouterContext)` returning `{ codeHosts: { connections: { list, remove }, gitlab: { connectToken }, repositories: { list } } }`, each `authed.codeHosts.<...>.handler(...)`:
  - `list`: `prisma.codeHostConnection.findMany({ where: { spaceId, userId }, orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } })` → `CodeHostConnection[]` (`createdAt.toISOString()`); never return ciphertext/metadata secrets.
  - `gitlab.connectToken`: resolve `deps.codeHosts.gitlab` (throw `ORPCError("NOT_FOUND")` if undefined); `verified = await provider.connectToken({ baseUrl, token, signal: context.signal })`; normalized base URL from the provider; create the row with `createRowId()` + `secrets.put(JSON.stringify({ token }), adapterContext, { recordId: id })`; `metadata: { identity, scopes }`; `label: verified.label`; `authKind: "token"`. Map errors as in "Error handling".
  - `repositories.list`: load the row by `{ id: connectionId, spaceId, userId }` (else `IsolationError`), `loadCodeHostConnection`, `provider.listRepositories(ref, query)`.
  - `connections.remove`: `deleteCodeHostConnection(...)`.
  - Build the `AdapterContext` like `connectionContext` in `apps/api/src/routes/connections.ts:205-217`.
- **UPDATE** `apps/api/src/router.ts`: add `codeHosts: CodeHostProviders` to `RouterDeps` and `...codeHostsRoutes(ctx)` to `createRouter`.
- **UPDATE** `apps/api/src/app.ts`: add `codeHosts?: CodeHostProviders` to `CreateAppOverrides`; build `const codeHosts = overrides.codeHosts ?? createCodeHostProviders({ fetch: createSafeRemoteFetch(undefined, undefined, { allowPrivateEndpoint: env.mcpAllowPrivateEndpoint }) })` (this reuses the deployment's existing private-endpoint escape; no new env var) and pass `codeHosts` into `createRouter({...})`.
- **UPDATE** `apps/api/src/security-audit.ts` `AUDITED_PROCEDURES`: `"codeHosts.gitlab.connectToken": { type: "credential.created", kind: "code_host" }`, `"codeHosts.connections.remove": { type: "credential.deleted", kind: "code_host", fields: ["connectionId"] }` (check the existing entries for the exact shape and that `kind` accepts a new string; extend the kind union in `packages/contracts/src/security-events.ts` if it is an enum).
- **GOTCHA**: oRPC context runs under `asTenant` already; don't wrap in `runAsSystem`. The `metadata` filter in `recordSecurityEvent` drops `token`-like keys, but never pass the token anyway.

### CREATE `packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** shared suite with a harness map (GitHub joins in the next slice):
```ts
interface Harness { provider: CodeHostProvider; emulator: CodeHostEmulator; baseUrl(): string; goodToken: string; narrowToken: string; repoPath: string }
```
